claims.text: The Chief Secretary and Secretary to Cabinet announces that, under the Public Holidays Act and in honour of the State Funeral of King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV, 19 September 2006 has been appointed a public holiday. The Tongan notice (FANONGONONGO) is dated 13/09/06.
claims.locator: Tongan FANONGONONGO heading and English 'Announcement of Public Holiday'; article timestamp Sep 14, 2006, 09:00
claims.uncertainty: The funeral day as appointed in advance; the burial is reported separately (to_crown_tupou_iv_burial_reported_20060920). The Tongan notice is dated 13 September (document_date) and the PMO article 14 September (published_date); the English text carries no date of its own.
